arguments.explanation: I am calculating the total market value of Technology sector holdings per portfolio and the total market value of all holdings per portfolio. Then, I calculate the percentage of the Technology sector value relative to the total portfolio value. I am joining the holdings, securities, and sectors tables to filter by the 'Technology' sector.
arguments.sql:
WITH PortfolioTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        h.portfolio_id,
        SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS total_portfolio_value
    FROM holdings h
    JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id
    GROUP BY h.portfolio_id
),
TechTotals AS (
    SELECT 
        h.portfolio_id,
        SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_value
    FROM holdings h
    JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id
    JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id
    WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Technology'
    GROUP BY h.portfolio_id
)
SELECT 
    p.portfolio_name,
    COALESCE(t.tech_value, 0) AS tech_value,
    pt.total_portfolio_value,
    ROUND(COALESCE(t.tech_value, 0) * 100.0 / pt.total_portfolio_value, 2) AS tech_percentage
FROM portfolios p
JOIN PortfolioTotals pt ON p.portfolio_id = pt.portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN TechTotals t ON p.portfolio_id = t.portfolio_id
ORDER BY tech_percentage DESC;
arguments.question: For each portfolio, show the total value of Technology sector holdings and what percentage it represents of the total portfolio value.

result.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) AS tech_value, total_portfolio.total_value, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) / total_portfolio.total_value, 2) AS tech_percentage FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON h.security_id = s.security_id JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id JOIN (SELECT portfolio_id, SUM(quantity * current_price) AS total_value FROM holdings JOIN securities USING (security_id) GROUP BY portfolio_id) AS total_portfolio ON p.portfolio_id = total_portfolio.portfolio_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Technology' GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, total_portfolio.total_value ORDER BY tech_percentage DESC

records.question: Find portfolios that have holdings in more than 5 different sectors and show their diversification metrics

actual.answer:
The following portfolio has holdings in more than 5 different sectors:

| Portfolio Name | Sector Count | Total Holdings | Diversification Ratio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Total Stock Market Index Fund | 6 | 12 | 0.5 |

arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    p.portfolio_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS sector_count, 
    COUNT(h.holding_id) AS total_holdings,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT s.sector_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(h.holding_id), 3) AS diversification_ratio
FROM portfolios p
JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id
JOIN securities sec ON h.security_id = sec.security_id
JOIN sectors s ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id
GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
HAVING sector_count > 5
ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC;

FROM portfolios p
JOIN holdings h ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id
JOIN securities sec ON h.security_id = sec.security_id
JOIN sectors s ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id
GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
HAVING sector_count > 5
ORDER BY diversification_ratio DESC;

GROUP BY p.portfolio_id
